verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs say it lets you collect, query, visualize and explore metrics, logs and traces in one platform. It documents specific pivots that carry context: metrics-to-logs with preserved label filters, metrics-to-traces via Prometheus exemplars, Tempo linking traces to logs and metrics, and entity views showing all signals together. A community user independently confirms Grafana Cloud offers metrics, logs and tracing together, though another reports that linking self-hosted Loki with SaaS Prometheus is not easy. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting, and smooth context linking in hybrid self-hosted/SaaS deployments.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
It helps you collect metrics, logs, traces, and profiles from your applications
Experience the magic of switching from metrics to logs with preserved label filters.
Prometheus exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces by clicking on recorded exemplars.
Tempo lets you search for traces, generate metrics from spans, and link your tracing data with logs and metrics.
Open an entity to see its insights and its metrics, logs, traces, and profiles.
